description: This Java class 'WithDittoHeadersChecker' provides assertion utility methods for testing and verifying properties of 'WithDittoHeaders' objects within the Ditto framework. It validates headers such as schema version, correlation ID, and authorization subjects.

classes.name: WithDittoHeadersChecker
classes.description: A utility class that performs assertions on WithDittoHeaders objects, used to verify headers in tests.

methods.name: WithDittoHeadersChecker
methods.description: Constructor that takes a WithDittoHeaders object to perform assertions on.

methods.name: hasDittoHeaders
methods.description: Asserts that the actual object's DittoHeaders matches the expected headers.

methods.name: hasEmptyDittoHeaders
methods.description: Asserts that the actual object's DittoHeaders are empty.

methods.name: hasSchemaVersion
methods.description: Checks if the actual headers contain a specific schema version.

methods.name: hasCorrelationId
methods.description: Checks if the actual headers contain a specific correlation ID.

methods.name: containsAuthorizationSubject
methods.description: Verifies that the headers include the specified authorization subjects.
